iou_denominator: union of frame indices where either target track has a box; absent box scores zero; both absent excluded and separately counted
target_track_windows: original X06a FMH truth utterances and each synthetic gap separately; all global 5fps frames included
throughput: candidate decode-and-detection pipeline elapsed wall / all FMH media duration, including startup/drain; excludes separate original-detector reference pass and agreement analysis
decode: sequential native-frame grab, retrieve only globally requested 5fps frames; original resolution; nearest native frame with last-frame clamp; gaps hold terminal source frame
